items.title: Etta Jones interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, October 2, 1998
items.q: Norman Simmons, yeah. Houston got the group together

ctx.x: And Norman Simmons plays on it?

Norman Simmons, yeah. Houston got the group together, because he always knows. If I’m going to record certain songs he wants certain musicians he thinks would be best for that type of music I’m doing. So I listen to him. It hasn’t been bad so far.
